item.tib: spral pa'i sku mchog blo ldan snying po'i gsung 'bum las lho phyogs dur khrod mjal snang
item.coloph: de ltar rmi lam 'khrul snang 'di/ dkar chag yi ger btab pa yang / mkha' 'gro gnyen la bzod par gsol/ 'di bris ge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis/ nam mkhas khyab pa'i 'gro ba rnams/ bon nyid dbyings su sangs rgyas shog kha ba can ljongs bod yul du/ bstan pa mi nub dar rgyas nas/ nyi shar ci bzhin bkra shis shog/
